items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: And Walter Johnson was on drums which to me is one of the smoothest drummers that ever lived... I admire Walter so much.

ctx.x: That's right, I always heard that.
Never, his shirt never wilted or nothing. He was as sharp as he could be. A very neat gentleman and a quiet gentleman. I admire Walter so much. And that was the band.
